note: GROUP slip — the twelve-frame `98 · RELAPSE — POST-SLIP` flow and its nineteen response cards, all at /slip. NOT /relapse, which draws the older four-frame `36 · Relapse` authoring of the same four beats (D147). Every entry below runs on scripts/vicifull/shot.mjs, which is what scripts/vicifull/audit.mjs drives — the previous file's `do` strings were .vicifull/slipshot.mjs argument lists and the audit could not run them. `.vicifull/drive.js`'s tap() DOES work on this build; slipshot.mjs is a convenience, not a necessity.
seeds: `.vicifull/f-slip-seed{0,1,2}-2340.js` sign a mock account (Jerry, day 13, a pledge signed six days ago) in before the first paint with 0 / 1 / 2 slips already on today's log — 98G, 98H and 98I are chosen by that count — AND freeze the page clock at tonight 23:40, which is what makes 98E read “Tonight · 11:40 PM” and 98C's wheel centre on 11 / 40 / PM instead of the capture host's own time (F28). `-nopledge-2340.js` is the same account with no pledge, for the state D148 says 98J must not be drawn in.
tool: sh .vicifull/f-slip-run.sh <Frame.html> <slug> <route> <seedfile|-> <do|-> captures both sides and block-diffs the PNGs; .vicifull/f-slip-blocks.mjs is the diff (8x8 block means over the whole frame, only the D009 status bar excluded).
entryPoints: D147 gives /slip two doors in the product, both in src/components/urge/index.tsx (the `sos` group's file). DRIVEN AND VERIFIED: the urge hub's 'I slipped' — `node scripts/vicifull/shot.mjs app "/urge-hub" … --do='await tap("I slipped")'` lands on /slip with 98A drawn. NOT DRIVEN: the surf board's 'I slipped — log it' (`logSlip()`), because `WaveStage` sits behind three timed SOS stages (breathe → tap → odd) that only `onDone` advances; `.vicifull/f-slip-sosexit.js` walks `.vicifull/drives/sos-done.js`'s path and stops at 'Breathe with me.', where the control does not exist yet. It is the same one-line `router.replace('/slip')` as the verified door, and it is recorded as unverified rather than assumed.
copySweep: `node scripts/vicifull/copy-sweep.mjs Email-Login --missing` reports exactly four missing strings across all 31 frames — 'Sat Jul 18', 'Sun Jul 19', 'Wed Jul 22', 'Thu Jul 23', the impossible date column of D150. Every other string in the group is in src/.
auditResult: `node scripts/vicifull/audit.mjs --group=slip` on these recipes: 31 frames — CLEAN 28, DIFF 3, unreachable 0, capture failed 0, NO RECIPE 0. Block-diffing all 31 of the audit's own captured pairs (8x8 means over the whole page, only the D009 status bar excluded): 29 of 31 at 0 of 19502 blocks over 4/255. The two that are not, and the three DIFF rows, are each accounted for and none is a paint loss: (a) `Slip When` net 22 / 5 missing / 224 blocks — every one of those blocks lies in x 84…172, the date column of D150, which the canvas draws as six days' labels in five rows; nothing at all differs past x 180. (b) `Slip Pledge` 1 missing — the canvas's 0 x 0 empty `<span>` spacer opposite the signature, which the app expresses as `alignItems: 'flex-end'` (D022). 0 blocks. (c) `Slip Begin Again` net 1 and 48 blocks, worst 6.0 — the net row is `opacity: 0.5 -> -` on the sun's grain, because `src/components/ui/Grain.tsx` emits a wrapper `View` plus an `<Image>` that carries the opacity where the canvas states one div, and the signature reads the wrapper; the blocks are the grain TILE PHASE, 0 of 19502 over 8/255, and the tiling was checked by eye at 2x rather than inferred — 96 x 96 on both sides, not the F31 magnification. Every group that uses `Grain` will show that row.
captureArtefact: Expo's dev-server overlay — a dark rounded square with a lightning bolt — drops into the bottom-left corner of the app page at random while Metro is rebuilding under another agent's edit. It is exactly 120 8x8 blocks at delta 217 and it is NOT the app. `.vicifull/f-slip-blocks.mjs` names it when every differing block falls inside it; the answer is to re-take the shot, and three of the nineteen cards needed that.
blurLayers: F26/F44/D091/D113 and then D151. The group's 31 frames carry exactly two kinds of blurred layer, both now drawn as the canvas states them rather than approximated: (a) 16 ground shadows — a flat rgba(0,0,0,0.10-0.14) ellipse under blur(4-5px), i.e. a blurred SOLID, which D010 never covered. Measured on `Slip Entry` down the shadow's centre at x 208, design vs app, y 386/390/394/398/402/406/410/414 and the spill 5pt outside the box: 0/255 on all eleven sample points, where the box-clipped radial was half as tall and a quarter too dark. (b) 21 warm washes — a two-stop closest-side ramp under blur(4px). D010 absorbed that and D151 retires the exemption; measured per pixel over each wash's own box with nothing masked, the unblurred ramp was worst 6/255 in the CORE of `Slip Morning After`'s 140pt wash (mean |d| 0.34) and 5/255 on `Slip Entry`'s (mean 0.41). With the canvas's own FeGaussianBlur they are worst 2 and 1, mean 0.14 and 0.10. The declared signature consequence is D091's: each blurred layer reports one row 3sigma larger than the frame's own div, because the div is not what the canvas paints — those are the `extra` rows in the audit line.
